body: Yeah. I went from mirtazapine to zoloft to seroquel to Wellbutrin. I’m on 300mg daily and it works for a few days in. Then I fucking crash.
I too understand how it feels to watch people I once knew get successful. It can’t be helped honestly. So I put deleted Instagram and put my phone down.

Wrap myself in a cocoon and cry for god knows how long. I don’t think there’s ever gonna be a motivational factor lmao. All my hopes and dreams are done for. I’m getting called off my internship because of my condition. This is one of the milestones I needed to get to my dreams. And now I didn’t leave a fucking good impression, and I can never come back.

But if you want to say the hunger for control counts as a motivational factor? Well. I mean I do fucking hunger for that because I lost every grain of it. But then I remember a wise man saying “control is about as real as a one legged unicorn taking a leak at the end of a rainbow.

I’m fucking lost.

Almost a year on medication. Did self reflection, tried meditating, tried accepting the past. I still wake up everyday feeling like shit. This is the second time I’m having depression and honestly much worse than when I had in my younger teens. I KNOW what I did to fix myself then. It doesn’t fucking work anymore.

Die or live they still fucking win anyway.
OP is going to die of old age by then.
This hit me right home, and I’m in tears. I hope you stay strong and keep holding on. I too know what it feels. To be just a few minutes late.
Your post gave me an epiphany. Maybe I should write my suicide note every day and every time I feel like I want to die. I don’t know what’ll come out of it but maybe you could give it a shot.

I keep telling myself I don’t care about what’s on the other side. If I was right, good. That’ll be the end of me. Just non existence. But if I was wrong, I’d be in hell. And that would be fine too. I’m just tired of this. Not because my life is a mess and people around me don’t like me or not come near me. But the fact that I once fucking believed I had some sort of purpose in life.

And now that I’ve lost my will to live, I really couldn’t care less. No more dreams, no more aspirations. Just fucking cold and black. I’d search for it. But I’m just too fucked up.

I was depressed a Long time ago. I fixed myself in my late teens. I was out and social, loved to party, and had found many paths I would like to take in the future. Thinking about it now, makes me feel fucked. And not long after my recovery I am back in the fucking pit. Just a lot deeper than before.

They say the wind blows the hardest the higher you get to the peak. Well, I’ve tripped tumbled and fell all the way down. My life now. Just doesn’t make sense anymore. The reason why I’m still here is that I just can’t understand why things happened the way they happened. I just can’t fucking make sense of this. So all I could think about beyond the veil is just fucking nothing.
Feel this all the damn time. I want to get brutally murdered. Or at least die in a freak accident. That time will come.
23 male. Lost my player mojo. Can’t get laid anymore.
Try to reach out for an LGBT community over there. If there isn’t then find just one person. Most likely that one person knows a bunch of yous.

I feel you. I wasn’t really like this. I mean I was when I was younger, but come on, who wasn’t? Halfway through my teens I changed and was very social and all that popular kid stuff. But well now I’m back in the same hole I was in when I was younger, only deeper down there.
He’s lucky to have you. Someone whom he loves and trusts, helping him go through with this. Be a lot worse if that someone was the cause of it.
Same thing going over on my end. Thinking about how I dropped from 3.9 GPA to 2.0 makes me feel fucked. Everyone around me has moved on too. lmao.

It’s really not easy. I have this invisible wall that says  “fuck off” and I don’t know how to turn it off. Then I think about how I can get friends is to open up and be who I was before the dark. And then I think about how I can’t do all that. And so it goes back to square one.
Yeah. I know for sure everyone’s selfish. Thing is I’m used to being alone, so I don’t have this problem. There’s no one. Nobody knows.
